divergences: Conflict-free correctness scope: Impl 1 claims to prove bank() conflict-free for every butterfly pair at every stride; Impl 2 explicitly limits its proof to (bank,offset) bijection + single-stride operand-pair distinctness and refuses the full 8-way/16-read simultaneous claim → spec never pins the actual schedule/addr_gen that defines 'no conflict'.
Twiddle-ROM addressing: both fall back to a bit-reversed psi-power table but compute the address differently (Impl 2 uses addr=(1<<stage)+block); spec leaves f(stage,block) source-missing.
FSM transition table: each reconstructs a different walk (spec itself carries three contradictory lists) → exact control flow left open.
Forward/inverse butterfly convention (CT/DIT forward + GS/DIF inverse) is assumed by both but spec only pins 'DIT, merged psi-twist'.
Host/PCIe/DMA framing: Impl 1 invents an AXI4-Stream 64-bit/4-coeff pack and round-trips it; Impl 2 declines to model it → spec marks the whole interface invented.
Naive radix-4 add/sub baseline (10) anchoring the 20% claim is assumed by both but flagged reconstructed.

property_checks.property: Conflict-free memory mapping (arbitrary radix/#BU, no bank conflict)
property_checks.evidence: Both use a self-admitted [conv] XOR-fold, not the paper's Sec.III function; Impl 2 explicitly proves only pairwise/bijection, not the full simultaneous 8-way property.
Both place bit-reversal inside the twiddle-ROM index (bit-reversed psi-power table), directly contradicting the paper's no-bit-reversal datapath — the headline contribution is not reproduced.
Both broadcast one twiddle to 8 lanes but use a standard bit-reversed ROM, not the rearranged-loop addressing that produces the reuse claimed.
Both verify GS_INTT(CT_NTT(x))==x at N=16 and negacyclic mult vs schoolbook mod x^N+1.
Both prove 2 mults & 8 add/sub vs naive 3/10; correctly anchored to naive radix-4, not radix-2.
Both verify the fused radix-4 equations equal the DFT4 matrix.

property_checks.property: ~50% butterfly hardware saved via symmetric operators
property_checks.evidence: Resource/area claim, not in a functional SMT model.

structural_findings: The paper's central contribution — the conflict-free interleaved-BRAM addressing function — is replaced in both impls by a placeholder XOR-fold; the actual scheme is not reconstructed.
Bit-reversal is reintroduced via the twiddle ROM index, so the architecture is NOT the bit-reversal-free datapath the reference describes.
Functional/algebraic models only: neither captures the cycle-accurate 9-stage pipeline, crossbar spine, or the rearranged scheduling/FSM that distinguish this specific FPGA core from a generic NTT.
Host PCIe/DMA boundary is invented (Impl 1) or omitted (Impl 2); the reference core's I/O interleaving is not represented.

summary: Reproducibility is mid: every numeric parameter (q, psi, omega, Ninv, Barrett, widths, op counts) is firmly pinned and the impls agree on them, but the spec leaves the system's defining structure — the conflict-free bank function, crossbar permutation, rearranged-loop twiddle addressing and FSM — source-missing, so the two impls diverge on exactly those points. Fidelity is limited by the same gap: the impls reproduce a correct negacyclic radix-2/4 NTT with the right constants, but the paper's headline contributions (conflict-free mapping and no-bit-reversal datapath) are unverifiable or outright violated, leaving essentially a generic-correct NTT rather than the specific CFNTT architecture.
guessed: Forward/inverse butterfly algorithm -> Cooley-Tukey DIT forward + Gentleman-Sande DIF inverse (Longa-Naehrig merged-negacyclic); spec pins only 'DIT, merged psi-twist' and is explicit this is [conv]
Twiddle ROM addressing -> standard bit-reversed psi-power table (psi_rev[i]=psi^bitrev(i)); spec says the paper's rearranged-loop f(stage,block) is [source-missing]
Conflict-free bank function -> bank(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^((i>>6)&7)^((i>>9)&1), offset=i>>3 (the committed XOR-fold; spec says paper's Sec.III function is source-missing)
per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s -> the permutation induced by bank() at stride 2^s (paper's explicit table source-missing)
modulus q -> 12289 (spec says paper states only '14-bit NTT-friendly prime')
psi -> 1945 = 11^6 mod 12289 (generator g=11 is reproduction-transcribed)
negacyclic vs cyclic -> negacyclic (psi 2N-th root); spec says transform_flavor is 'unstated in source'
Host/PCIe/DMA boundary -> AXI4-Stream, 64-bit beats, 4x 14-bit coeffs/beat, little-endian pack; spec marks the whole host interface reproduction-invented [source-missing]
e2e reduced size -> N=16 with psi_16=psi^64 (taken from metadata.spec.verification.e2e_N=16)
radix-4 j-rotator -> j=psi^512 (order 4, j^2=-1); used multiply-free
naive radix-4 add/sub baseline -> 10 (spec flags this reconstructed; if paper differs the 20% anchor moves)
Barrett correction bound -> at most 2 conditional subtractions (spec pins <=2 over impl disagreement)

Negacyclic NTT algorithm form -> Longa-Naehrig merged-psi CT forward / GS inverse with a bit-reversed psi-power twiddle table (spec pins only 'DIT, merged psi-twist negacyclic'; bit-reversal lives in the ROM index, contradicting the paper's claimed no-bit-reversal datapath)
Twiddle-ROM address function f(stage,block) -> addr = (1<<stage)+block with bit-reversed psi-power contents (paper's rearranged-loop addressing is source-missing)

Conflict-free correctness target -> verified only as (bank,offset) bijection + per-butterfly operand-PAIR bank-distinctness (single-bit-stride). The full 8-way / 16-read simultaneous no-conflict property depends on the addr_gen schedule, which is source-missing, so it is NOT proven
Radix-4 j-rotator value -> j = psi^512 (order-4, j^2=-1); verified the radix-4 BU equations equal the DFT4 matrix with root j
Barrett correction bound -> at most 2 conditional subtractions of q over x in [0,(q-1)^2] (spec pins <=2; exact paper bound source-missing)
Host/PCIe/DMA AXI-Stream framing -> not modeled functionally (spec flags it reproduction-invented, not on the verified axis)
FSM transition table -> reconstructed IDLE->LOAD->RUN_STAGE(loop)->NEXT_STAGE->(SCALE if INTT)->STORE->DONE->IDLE; exact paper table source-missing
Tier-2 reduced instance -> N=16, same q=12289, psi16 = psi^64 (primitive 32nd root), ninv16 = 16^-1 mod q (per metadata.spec.verification.e2e_N)
